Pricing

Two infrastructure packages

Both packages include deployment, monitoring, offsite backups, and administrator training. I quote application modules, migration, and hosting as separate items.

Single-host deployment

Standard · Non-HA

For workloads that can tolerate occasional downtime.

$3,000–$6,000One-time estimate · USD
  • Physical host or VPS
  • Docker Compose by default
  • Monitoring, TLS, and offsite backups
  • Documented recovery and administrator handoff

Redundant deployment

High Availability · HA

For business-critical workloads with defined recovery goals.

$8,000–$15,000+One-time estimate · USD
  • Managed Kubernetes or custom self-managed HA
  • Replicated workloads where supported
  • Database, storage, and ingress design per workload
  • GitOps, restoration tests, and incident runbooks

Before you start

Pricing, availability, and examples

What does the package price include?

The infrastructure range covers deployment, monitoring, backup configuration, documentation, and administrator training. I quote application modules, migration, hardware, hosting, and optional support as separate items. The final quote confirms the deliverables and recurring costs.

Will self-hosting cost less than my subscriptions?

It depends on your workload and the time needed to operate it. The calculator includes setup, hosting, backups, labor, and scheduled replacements. Select the applications you need and enter your own bills. The sample subscriptions show how the calculator works. You still need to define your replacement setup.

Does the HA package guarantee no downtime?

No. High availability requires compatible applications, redundant databases and storage, and tested failover across independent failure domains. We agree on recovery goals and acceptance tests before implementation.

Can I see an example before requesting a quote?

The portfolio includes the Antalos infrastructure and Emiliany commerce case studies. The operations demo runs in a simulation with no access to live customer systems.
